description: Save a version of the current project state. The person flicks between versions in the editor to compare or roll back, so one version per logical change-set (not one per tool call) is what they can revisit. `name` is shown verbatim in the version picker, so a short description reads best (e.g. "add slide-in animation").

name.description: Short label describing what this set of changes accomplished. Defaults to a timestamp if omitted, but a description is much more useful to the user.

projectId.description: Project to save a version of (filename stem).

name: save_version

outputSchema.description: The result envelope every Morpha tool returns.

data.description: The payload, shaped by the tool.

editorUrl.description: Opens this project in the editor.

note.description: What to do next when not ready.

status.description: For cache-backed readers: whether the answer was ready.
